latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release with static 3D visualization utilities for Rerun SDK:

- Add static methods for displaying point clouds, trajectories, cameras, planes, and chessboards in Rerun viewers.
- No manual viewer management needed; all methods are static.
- Supports visualization of SLAM data, robot poses, calibration targets, and debugging scenes.
- Compatible with SE(3)/SO(3) matrix utilities from related skills.
- Ensures data type and color format compatibility with Rerun SDK.
- Provides detailed usage examples and quick start documentation.
